definitions.text_mt: Klassi jew terminu li jfisser press.
Klassi jew terminu li jfisser print.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm preżenza ċara ta' stampa fit-tfassil tax-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: There was a clear presence of press in the design of the work.

definitions.text_mt: Cifra u valur użat fit-għadd jew fit-telefon.

usage_examples.mt: Kiteb in-numru tat-telefon uffiċjali fuq il-karta.
usage_examples.en: He wrote the official phone number on the paper.

usage_examples.mt: Stenna r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu bil-għaqal u l-impenn.
usage_examples.en: He performed to wait responsibly and with commitment.

definitions.text_mt: Iffassal ittri jew simboli fuq saba' jew karta minn fomm sa test.
Jikteb u jinkludi nies fi grupp jew armata.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kittieb kiteb rumanz storiku dwar Malta fis-seklu tmintax.
usage_examples.en: The writer wrote a historical novel about Malta in the eighteenth century.
